body:
kv-cache: fix restoring mismatched KV cache rotation by saving exact rotation metadata ( #28498 )

kv-cache: save exact KV rotation metadata, reject restoring mismatched rotation

tests : move the state rotation test to test-save-load-state

the test is now part of the save/load test matrix and runs against

every model under test, like the rest of the suite

it probes the KV cache type combinations supported by the model and

treats models that do not use attention rotation as passing vacuously

Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/Qwen3.8-27B

- cont : skip unsupported KV caches

summaryZh: llama.cpp b11411版本主要修复了KV缓存旋转元数据保存与恢复不匹配的问题，并完善了相关的测试矩阵。此更新确保了模型状态在保存和加载过程中的一致性，避免了因旋转逻辑错误导致的推理异常。
